inference_configuration.coordinate_space: normalized [0,1000] mapped directly to original viewport; inclusive 1000 maps to last pixel

notes: One trial per predefined case; separate from official leaderboard.
Raw traces and screenshots remain in ignored local evidence storage.
Optional fields left untouched do not establish successful checkout.
Peak MLX allocation excludes other process and OS memory.
Local API charges zero; energy cost unmeasured.
Final-field correctness can include scenario-provided autofill; it is not a count of fields entered by the model.
Completed case attempts do not imply completed model responses or successful checkouts.
Cancelled calls have no completed response, and no complete loading, prefill, partial-token or peak-memory measurements.
Reported peak MLX allocation is the largest among completed responses, not a global peak including cancelled calls.
Fixed-budget evaluation timeouts are distinct from demonstrated model reasoning errors.
System-wide paging and warning-level memory pressure were sampled; sole causation and thermal throttling are unproven.
The requested 4.25 GB MLX memory setting is a graph-evaluation guideline, not a hard process-memory cap.

configuration_evidence_coverage.note: A trial without a completed response retains declared adapter configuration and execution binding, but has no completed worker-reported runtime measurements.

truncation_measurement_scope: Completed model responses only; truncation is unknown for cancelled calls.
measurement_scope: Quantized local system completion within a fixed 180-second task budget on an 8-GiB Apple M1; one trial per case.

cold_model_loading_seconds.scope: Completed cold calls only; warm-call zero placeholders excluded.
